definitions.explanation: Describes sleeping very deeply and peacefully.

examples.japanese: ゆうべはぐっすり{眠|ねむ}れた。
{赤|あか}ちゃんがぐっすり{寝|ね}ている。
{疲|つか}れてぐっすり{眠|ねむ}った。
examples.english: I was tired and slept deeply.

examples.japanese: {静|しず}かな{部屋|へや}でぐっすり{眠|ねむ}ることができた。
examples.english: I was able to sleep soundly in the quiet room.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}をした{後|あと}は、いつもぐっすり{寝|ね}られる。{朝|あさ}まで{一度|いちど}も{目|め}が{覚|さ}めない。
examples.english: After exercising, I always sleep soundly. I don't wake up even once until morning.

notes:
ぐっすり is an onomatopoeic adverb for deep sleep.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぐっすり{眠|ねむ}る (to sleep soundly)
- ぐっすり{寝|ね}る (to sleep deeply)
- ぐっすり{眠|ねむ}れる (to be able to sleep well)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ぐっすり (soundly, deeply)
- すやすや (peacefully - often for babies)
- ぐーぐー (snoring sounds, sleeping)
- ころっと{寝|ね}る (to fall asleep easily)

NOTE: This is a mimetic word ({擬態語|ぎたいご}) expressing a state rather than a sound.
